name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs, orders, and renders hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home sections using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Manager creation, ordering, rendering, and Abyss customization for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Loads the configured media bar without waiting for unrelated custom rows; fixes My List heart updates and lingering Home breadcrumbs; bounds artwork requests while preserving the no-wrong-slide startup; and moves selected top-navigation text color into its own settings section.
